title: Try Shipvo in your browser: a phone, device features and a rollback

retention.hook: 0-3 s: a shop on a phone inside a browser page, headline 'Nothing to install'.
retention.promise: By 8 s: you tap a shop on Android and iOS, test a payment, and watch an update roll back, with no account.

openLoops.question: What happens to a bad update?
openLoops.paysOff: update scene (about 60 s), the phone goes back to version 1 by itself

openLoops.question: Can I try many phones at once?
openLoops.paysOff: many scene (about 75 s), six phones from one link

reHooks: flash cards in every scene: 'No account' (hook), 'Android + iOS', 'Dark mode', 'Payment: approved', 'Signed', 'Rolled back', 'One link'
retention.payoff: A bad update rolls back by itself, and a wall of phones opens from one link.
retention.nextStep: shipvo.dev/playground, then npx shipvo run android

scenes.narration: This phone runs in your browser. You installed nothing. By the end, you will have tapped a shop on Android and iOS, tested a payment, and watched a bad update roll back.
Open shipvo dot dev, slash playground. A shop called Tide and Tackle appears. Tap Add on two products. The cart says two items.
scenes.caption: Open shipvo.dev/playground. A shop called Tide and Tackle appears. Tap Add on two products. The cart says two items.

scenes.narration: Select iOS, and the same app shows on an iPhone. Select Android to go back. Now try dark mode and large text. The app stays readable.
Real phones know where they are, and can pay. You choose the answer. Pick Lisbon for the location. Approve the payment. Turn airplane mode on. The app shows each choice.

Now the hard part. Publish a signed update. Shipvo checks the signature. It goes to a tenth of cohorts, then to all of them. Now crash it. Three starts in a row fail. On the fourth, the phone goes back to version one, by itself.
Last, add more phones. Pick up to twelve, Android, iOS or both. Copy the link, and whoever opens it sees your setup.
That is a phone, a payment and a rollback, with no install. Try it at shipvo dot dev, slash playground. Next, see your own app on a phone with shipvo run.
scenes.caption: That is a phone, a payment and a rollback, with no install. Try it at shipvo.dev/playground. Next, see your own app on a phone with shipvo run.
